The '''1930–31 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by two points over nearest rival [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]]. [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]] and [[East Fife F.C.|East Fife]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1931–32 Scottish Division Two]].
